restart.closed.assistant.text: Hive closed unexpectedly: last seen {lastSeen}. {agentCount, plural, =0 {No agents were running.} other {{agentCount} agent(s) were running: {agents}. {resumed}}}{still, plural, =0 {} other { {still} process(es) the agents started are still running; the user can stop them from Hive's notice.}} Check for card loops and lanes that stalled and tell the user; don't restart or stop anything yourself.
restart.closed.assistant.note: The line the Assistant finds in its inbox after an unexpected close (#987, #1031). agents: each running agent as "name (project)", joined by commas; resumed: restart.closed.resumed or restart.closed.nothingResumed; still: the processes the agents had started that still run. It doesn't act itself: the user decides.

restart.closed.fact.text: Hive closed unexpectedly (last seen {lastSeen}); {agentCount} agent(s) of this workspace were running
restart.closed.fact.note: The journal's fact of an unexpected close (#1031): stored, so always the Default's.

restart.closed.nothingResumed.text: Nothing was resumed: the user decides.
restart.closed.nothingResumed.note: With Settings → Sessions → Resume agents after an unexpected close off (the default): the notice offers Resume All.

restart.closed.resumed.text: Hive resumed {resumed} of them (the user's setting){failed, plural, =0 {} other {; {failed} couldn't resume}}{held, plural, =0 {} other {; {held} left stopped (their slots are free, to resume by hand, or hold other work)}}.
restart.closed.resumed.note: With Settings → Sessions → Resume agents after an unexpected close on: how many were resumed, failed, and left stopped (#1434: their slots free, or holding other work).
